categories.title: Lock
categories.info: Locks require a certain combination to open. For locks that require specific keys, see Mechanisms.

categories.title: Merchant
categories.info: The Merchant appears in various locations in the game, selling upgrades in the form of briefcase size, weapon parts, different weapons and more. Merchant Requests may also be turned in for Spinel, which can be spent for greater rewards.

categories.title: Puzzle
categories.info: Puzzles, like mechanisms, require Leon to find pieces to complete. However, in addition, puzzles must also be solved in some way to progress.

categories.title: Typewriter
categories.info: Typewriters can be used to save the game, store items out of the inventory and customize the briefcase to grant various bonuses.

categories.title: Blue Medallion
categories.info: Blue Medallions appear in sets of 5, and must be shot to complete specific Merchant Requests.

categories.title: Clockwork Castellan
categories.info: Destroy all 16 Clockwork Castellan to receive the Primal Knife, with infinite durability.

categories.title: File
categories.info: Files are collectible items that provide lore or background information. Sometimes, an object must be interacted with in a specific way before the file is saved.

categories.title: Key
categories.info: Small Keys are used to open up locked Treasures.

categories.title: Key Item
categories.info: Key Items are necessary to the game's progression. They are usually used to open devices or activate mechanisms.

categories.title: Merchant Request
categories.info: Merchant Requests can be found on blue pieces of paper scattered across the world. Complete them for a reward.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasure are high-value artifacts, which can be sold to the Merchant. Locked Treasures require a Small Key to open. Gemstones may be socketed into certain Treasures, boosting their combined value.

categories.title: Ammo
categories.info: Ammo is used by Leon's various guns, and can be either found or crafted.

categories.title: Container
categories.info: Containers include all types of closed boxes, such as cupboards or lockers. They always contain 1 piece of randomized loot, based on Leon's status and inventory.

categories.title: Gunpowder
categories.info: Gunpowder is often found as spoils from enemies or inside barrels. It is used in many crafting recipes.

categories.title: Herbs & Meds
categories.info: Herbs & Meds restore Leon's Health. Herbs can be mixed with one another to combine their effects; only Green Herbs can be used on their own.

categories.title: Resources
categories.info: Resources are used in many Crafting recipes, notably for ammo.

categories.title: Weapon
categories.info: Weapons are used by Leon to fend off the various enemies. Firearms require specific ammunition, grenades are consumed upon use, while melee weapons break after their durability is used up.
